[SWS_LinIf_00507] ⌈The LIN Interface shall transit from LINIF_UNINIT to LINIF_-
CHANNEL_SLEEP without sending go-to-sleep command, when the function LinIf_-
Init is called.⌋()
Note: It is assumed that automatically external slave nodes will enter bus sleep mode
earliest after 4s and latest 10s of bus inactivity (as specified in the ISO 17987 spec-
ifications, see ISO 17987-2 [5] clause 5.4). AUTOSAR slave nodes are initialized in
sleep mode.
